# Aunt Jamesina

## Overview

- **Gender:** Female  <sub>[v3 c16 P52](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0052)</sub>
- **Status:** Widow  <sub>[v3 c16 P59](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0059)</sub>
- **Role:** Housekeeper for students  <sub>[v3 c9 P13](../source/v03-c09.md#nw-v03-c09-p0013)</sub>
- **Nicknames:** Aunt Jimsie  <sub>[v3 c9 P13](../source/v03-c09.md#nw-v03-c09-p0013)</sub>; Aunty J.  <sub>[v3 c24 P5](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0005)</sub>

## Appearance

She is a tiny old woman with a softly-triangular face, pink cheeks, and snow-white hair worn in quaint little puffs over her ears. Her large, soft blue eyes shine with unquenchable youth. She dresses in an old-fashioned style.

_Sources: [v3 c16 P52](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0052), [v3 c16 P53](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0053)_

## Personality

Aunt Jamesina is sweet, open-minded, and cheerful, holding a broad and tolerant philosophy on life. She prefers comfort and simplicity over strict rules, allowing the young women under her care full independence. She possesses a keen sense of humor, often teasing others or lightly joking about her own past and suitors. Deeply compassionate, she holds a strong affection for cats and believes in treating animals kindly.

_Sources: [v3 c9 P13](../source/v03-c09.md#nw-v03-c09-p0013), [v3 c16 P53](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0053), [v3 c16 P64](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0064), [v3 c16 P69](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0069), [v3 c19 P4](../source/v03-c19.md#nw-v03-c19-p0004), [v3 c35 P21](../source/v03-c35.md#nw-v03-c35-p0021), [v3 c35 P23](../source/v03-c35.md#nw-v03-c35-p0023)_

- Old-fashioned  <sub>[v3 c16 P53](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0053)</sub>
- Tolerant  <sub>[v3 c16 P53](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0053), [v3 c16 P64](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0064)</sub>

- Kindhearted  <sub>[v3 c9 P13](../source/v03-c09.md#nw-v03-c09-p0013), [v3 c16 P69](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0069)</sub>

## Abilities

- Knitting  <sub>[v3 c16 P52](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0052), [v3 c25 P2](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0002)</sub>
- Housekeeping  <sub>[v3 c9 P13](../source/v03-c09.md#nw-v03-c09-p0013)</sub>

## Goals

- To keep house for the college girls at Patty's Place  <sub>[v3 c9 P13](../source/v03-c09.md#nw-v03-c09-p0013)</sub>
- To get a yellow silk dress in heaven  <sub>[v3 c19 P6](../source/v03-c19.md#nw-v03-c19-p0006)</sub>

## History

Aunt Jamesina was named after her father, who drowned at sea shortly before her birth. After her daughter got married and moved to the mission field, she was left living alone in a large house until Philippa Gordon invited her to Kingsport to act as housekeeper for Anne Shirley, Priscilla Grant, Stella Maynard, and Philippa at Patty's Place. She accepted and brought along two cats, the Sarah-cat and Joseph, and later agreed to take in Anne's cat, Rusty. During her time at Kingsport, she managed the home, mothered the students, and provided humorous advice through their college years. When the girls graduated and went their separate ways, Aunt Jamesina moved home, taking all three cats with her. Later, despite her fear of snakes, she traveled to India to visit her daughter's mission field.

_Sources: [v3 c9 P13](../source/v03-c09.md#nw-v03-c09-p0013), [v3 c16 P51](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0051), [v3 c16 P55](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0055), [v3 c16 P59](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0059), [v3 c37 P12](../source/v03-c37.md#nw-v03-c37-p0012), [v3 c38 P8](../source/v03-c38.md#nw-v03-c38-p0008), [v4 c3 P16](../source/v04-c03.md#nw-v04-c03-p0016)_

## Background by volume

- Her father, James, was drowned at sea a month before she was born, leading to her name  <sub>[v3 c9 P13](../source/v03-c09.md#nw-v03-c09-p0013)</sub>
- Her late husband refused to let her wear yellow silk and named her cat the Sarah-cat  <sub>[v3 c16 P59](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0059), [v3 c19 P6](../source/v03-c19.md#nw-v03-c19-p0006)</sub>
- Her daughter, Elizabeth, earned an M.A. and became a foreign missionary  <sub>[v3 c9 P13](../source/v03-c09.md#nw-v03-c09-p0013), [v3 c27 P6](../source/v03-c27.md#nw-v03-c27-p0006), [v3 c36 P11](../source/v03-c36.md#nw-v03-c36-p0011)</sub>

## Quotes

> New shoes are smarter than old ones, but the old ones are more comfortable. I’m old enough to indulge myself in the matter of shoes and opinions.  <sub>[v3 c16 P53](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0053)</sub>

> Do your duty by God and your neighbor and yourself, and have a good time. That’s my philosophy and it’s always worked pretty well.  <sub>[v3 c19 P4](../source/v03-c19.md#nw-v03-c19-p0004)</sub>

> The very first thing I’m going to do when I get to heaven is to get a yellow silk dress.  <sub>[v3 c19 P6](../source/v03-c19.md#nw-v03-c19-p0006)</sub>

> You mustn’t marry anybody you don’t love, Phil, when all’s said and done  <sub>[v3 c19 P33](../source/v03-c19.md#nw-v03-c19-p0033)</sub>

> Work first and then play used to be my motto when I was a girl.  <sub>[v3 c35 P3](../source/v03-c35.md#nw-v03-c35-p0003)</sub>
